# Ink

Behavior JIT for production AI. Models handle novelty; Ink turns proven behavior into
software. Ink observes repeated, bounded, verifiable decisions and their independent
outcomes, qualifies behavior that has proven itself, serves it locally as Fast Paths, and
deoptimizes when reality changes. Serving authority comes from verified outcomes, not
similarity or confidence alone.

The Python SDK exposes Ink, DecisionSite, DecisionResult, FallbackResult, Outcome,
PromotionRequirements, decision, record_outcome, CandidateSite, discover_from_file, and
discover_from_traces. The CLI exposes ink discover, ink sites, ink status, ink inspect,
ink compile, ink evaluate, ink maintenance, ink value, ink export, ink retain,
ink model-install, and ink model-train.

Install: pip install ink-jit
Import: from ink import DecisionSite, Ink, FallbackResult
Evaluate without integrating: ink discover traces.jsonl

Read README.md and docs/: getting-started.md, concepts.md, architecture.md,
production-safety.md, integration.md, deployment.md, benchmarks.md, cli.md.

Local-first, explicit sites, conservative exact-state coverage, independent outcome
verification, randomized comparison traffic, and explicit deoptimization. No cloud
control plane, dashboard, workflow mining, or automatic framework attachment.
